Keyed by repo ("concordego" for ConcordeGo's notes), then a hash of the channel's source notes + tools/release-notes-prompt.md + the model (see channel_key in sync-releases.py). Written by tools/summarize-notes.py in the GitHub Action (model = the Claude model that wrote it) or by hand (model "hand"). Edit "bullets" freely: an entry is kept until its channel's notes change. "fold": true adds the closing "Plus smaller fixes and polish" line. An entry with "failed" is ignored by the page and asked again after 7 days; delete it to try sooner. Keep this file valid JSON: while it does not parse, nothing is summarized.

bullets: **Windows** — chats, searches the web, speaks and listens on Intel, AMD and ARM PCs; installs Ollama for you
**Video** — ask for a short clip and it renders on your Mac; a size ladder shows what each quality costs
**Export** — ask for an answer as a PDF, Word document, spreadsheet, slides, calendar file, CSV and more
**Removed** — Contribute and the free community image cloud
**Mac fix** — closing the window no longer crashes the app
**Vultr servers** — create a server at Vultr as well as DigitalOcean, with every location, the plans each sells, nearest marked
**DigitalOcean** — every region, dedicated-CPU sizes, and an optional API token saved in the Keychain
**Make primary** — any server can become the primary, so the old one can be removed; new servers can be measured right away
**Location menu** — pick Auto or any server from the menu bar, with a warning on one that is down
**NextDNS** — a server's details now show NextDNS and Home devices rows
**Server setup** — a NextDNS step that fails no longer reports done; Servers says why and how to retry. Pi and Debian installs continue
**DigitalOcean** — connecting the account repairs the cloud firewall for older exits that dropped UDP 3478
**Network changes** — joining or leaving the bond is picked up within 5 seconds instead of up to a minute
**ConcordeGo Lite** — a short search at /lite: say where you need to be, and it finds a few good flights to get you there
**Earliest or cheapest** — Lite shows the earliest arrival and the cheapest side by side, and opens a flight in place
**More details** — each Lite flight shows the aircraft, its on-time record and more
**Anything else?** — add requests as Lite searches, such as keeping certain airports out of the trip
